title: Barcelona by day and by night
description: docs/audio.md § Where music plays now: Barcelona's streets (the Avinguda Meridiana, Sants, Plaça d'Espanya, the Carmel bunkers, the Barceloneta) play concrete by day and mazmorra-2 by night, the way home included, and a fight there at night goes on to mazmorra-2. The overlay is the scenario's. Run with --chrome: just screenshots city-music --chrome.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.showMusic = (note = '') => { let el = document.querySelector('#music-check'); if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'music-check'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:9999;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#000c;color:#ffd6ec;font:14px/1.5 monospace;white-space:pre'; document.body.append(el); } const m = window.gerard.music; el.textContent = `♪ ${m.playing ?? 'silencio'} · ${m.position()?.toFixed(1) ?? '—'} s · ${window.gerard.story.night ? 'noche' : 'día'}${note ? `\n${note}` : ''}`; }; window.go = async id => { const { ENVIRONMENTS } = await import('/src/environments.ts'); window.gerard.game.setEnvironment(id, { ...ENVIRONMENTS[id].spawn }); };

steps.caption: Barcelona by day: concrete on the Avinguda Meridiana
